text: "What The Hell Macron", Trump Mocks Macron’s Sunglasses During World Economic Forum Speech | AC1ZU.S. President Donald Trump poked fun at French President Emmanuel Macron during his speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos on January 21, 2026. Referring to Macron’s appearance at Davos the previous day, Trump joked about the French leader’s aviator sunglasses, drawing laughter from the audience. Macron’s office later said the sunglasses were worn to protect his eyes due to a burst blood vessel.
